label: List instances
description: List every instance weft holds anything for in this project: saved values, connections, infra copies, instance tokens, trigger activations. One entry per instance with what it has (counts and states, never a value or a secret), including fires of its triggers that wait because a field is not filled yet, with the reason. For an admin overview, or a website that shows what is still missing.

outputs.name: instances
outputs.description: One entry per instance: `{ instance, values, connections, tokens, copies, triggers }`. `values`, `connections` and `tokens` are counts (tokens that still work); `copies` is its infra copies, each `{ node, instance, status, failure? }`; `triggers` is its trigger activations, each `{ trigger, mode, waiting? }`, where `waiting` is `{ fires, reason }` when fires wait on a value not given yet (`reason` names the field).

outputs.name: ids
outputs.description: Every instance's id, in the same order.

outputs.name: waiting
outputs.description: The instances with fires waiting on a value not given yet.
